base.name: Every Battle
base.description: Inherited by every troop that does not opt out. Battle events that should apply to all encounters live here rather than in the battle phase flows.

events.note: Ambush (BATTLE_START_DAMAGE): the party's summed trait rate hits ONE enemy as the battle opens. v.hit guards the FOR_EACH so only the first living enemy is struck -- no engine-side 'first enemy' ref needed. Lifted out of the battle_start flow so a troop can suppress it: an ambush on a boss that opens with a cutscene reads wrong.

Battle Strain. Ordinary rounds cost NOTHING -- taking a tactical turn is not supposed to be priced. Strain is exceptional pressure against indefinite combat: it begins after five completed rounds and escalates at ten and fifteen, scaling the combined MPD of the living party. Rounds 1-5 free, 6-9 x4, 10-14 x8, 15+ x16. This replaced a per-round drain of every ally's MPD, which charged the expedition for simply fighting and made a heavy party unaffordable in a way the design explicitly rejects. Lifted out of the round_end flow so a single fight can suppress it -- a scripted duel that is meant to last should not be priced like an expedition that has gone on too long.

then.name: strainMult
then.value: battle.round >= 15 and 16 or (battle.round >= 10 and 8 or (battle.round >= 6 and 4 or 0))

then.fallback: The prolonged battle strains the summoning! (-{0} MP)

wandering.name: Wandering Encounter
wandering.description: What a random encounter is, everywhere: a group rolled from the current map's own weighted encounter table. The table belongs to the map because it is the map that differs; the shape of the fight does not, so it is defined once here. A floor that wants something else names its own troop in `encounterTroop`.
